extDescription.message: Translate, rewrite and ask questions about any page — powered by your own Infomaniak AI account.

notConnectedBody.message: Kounata runs on your own Infomaniak AI credits. Connect your account to get started.

connectedBody.message: Requests are billed to your Infomaniak AI Tools credits.

stepOpenAiTools.message: Open AI Tools in the Infomaniak Manager and note your product ID

stepCreateToken.message: Create an API token with the ai-tools scope

fieldProductIdHint.message: The number shown in the AI Tools page of your Manager.

fieldTokenHint.message: Scope: ai-tools. Set an expiry date when you create it.

storageWarning.message: The token is stored locally in this browser only. It is never synchronised and never sent anywhere except api.infomaniak.com.

modelsEmpty.message: Connect your account to load the models available on your AI product.

tier_quick_hint.message: Inline rewriting and short translations. Favour a small, fast model.

tier_deep_hint.message: Side-panel conversation. Favour the strongest model you have.

fieldWritingAssistant.message: Show the writing assistant in text fields

poweredBy.message: Runs on your Infomaniak AI credits.

panelEmptyBody.message: Summarise it, pull out the key figures, or ask anything about what you are reading.

pageTranslated.message: Page translated. Run the action again to restore the original.

error_no_credentials.message: Connect your Infomaniak account in the settings first.

error_unauthorized.message: This API token was rejected. Check it or create a new one.

error_forbidden.message: This token cannot access that AI product. Check the ai-tools scope and the product ID.

error_not_found.message: Unknown AI product or model. Check the product ID in your Manager.

error_insufficient_credits.message: Your Infomaniak AI credits are exhausted.

error_rate_limited.message: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.

error_server_error.message: Infomaniak AI is unavailable right now.
